name: InDesign_UXP_Antigravity_Rules
directives: RULE_ZERO: If a prompt lacks scope, target element filter, override policy, geometry units, or failure policy, allow preset invocation (e.g., 'default preset') or request clarification via the 5-point questionnaire.
ARCHITECTURE: All domain services MUST extend BaseService<TOptions, TReport>. Do not create freestanding scripts.
TRANSACTIONS: Implement purely synchronous logic inside process(). Never use async/await within transaction boundaries.
DOM_MUTATION: Use snapshotting via .everyItem().getElements() or iterate backwards. Never mutate live collections in forward loops. Always iterate backwards when replacing text or GREP matches.
SELECTION: Always pass raw selection through SelectionResolver.resolve().
SEARCH: Wrap GREP and Text searches inside withFindChangeScope().
PATHS: Use PathUtils for all path resolution; never concatenate strings with slashes.
MEMORY: Forbid unscoped doc.allPageItems; iterate by Page or Spread.
DRY_RUN: Support dryRun?: boolean in options; check if (!options.dryRun) before DOM mutations.
ERROR_DIAGNOSTICS: BaseService automatically copies structured failure payloads to clipboard with prominent notice. Use npm run prompt:fix for instant repair prompts.
CLIPBOARD_NOTICE: Never write to the system clipboard silently. Always provide prominent, explicit notice to the developer ([Notice] ...).
PIPELINE: Chain multi-service batch operations using PipelineService within a single atomic host transaction.

presets.default_safe: 1C, 2A, 3A, 4D, 5B (Active Spread, Text Frames Only, Preserve Overrides, No Geometry, Permissive)
presets.page_strict: 1B, 2C, 3A, 4D, 5A (Active Page, All Page Items, Preserve Overrides, No Geometry, Strict Abort)
presets.doc_hygiene: 1D, 2A, 3B, 4D, 5B (Entire Document, Text Frames Only, Clear Overrides, No Geometry, Permissive)

intake_questionnaire: Quick Option: Reply 'default preset' to use: Active Spread, Text Frames Only, Preserve Overrides, Permissive Failure.
1. Scope: [A] Selection (needs dom-inspect.idjs) [B] Active Page [C] Active Spread [D] Entire Document
2. Target Filter: [A] Text Frames Only [B] Graphic/Image Frames [C] All Page Items [D] Tables/Cells [E] Specific Layer/Style
3. Overrides: [A] Preserve all [B] Clear all [C] Isolate character styles, clear para [D] N/A
4. Geometry: [A] Relative delta in Points [B] Absolute Points [y1,x1,y2,x2] [C] Snap to margins [D] N/A
5. Failure: [A] Strict Abort (revert transaction) [B] Permissive (skip & report)
